description: This is a test class for the HomePageDao in the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests for methods that retrieve home page data and module default page data based on user roles and priorities. The tests use fixtures and mock data to ensure correct ordering and filtering of pages.

classes.name: HomePageDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the HomePageDao functionality related to retrieving home pages and module default pages with respect to user roles and priorities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, truncates tables, loads fixture data, and instantiates the HomePageDao object.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderOneRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of home pages in priority order for a single role.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderMultipleRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of home pages in priority order for multiple roles.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderNoMatches
methods.description: Tests behavior when no home pages match the given role(s).

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityNoUserRoles
methods.description: Tests behavior when no user roles are provided (empty role list).

methods.name: compareHomePages
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual home page objects.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderOneRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of module default pages in priority order for a single role.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderMultipleRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of module default pages in priority order for multiple roles.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderNoMatches
methods.description: Tests behavior when no default pages match the given role(s).

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityNoUserRoles
methods.description: Tests behavior when no user roles are provided for default pages.

methods.name: compareModuleDefaultPages
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual module default page objects.
